Theorem
[Morrey's inequality] ↗ def:holder-seminorm-sup-norm 1. ch5:5.6-thm-4\group Sobolev Inequalities

Assume $n < p \le \infty $. Then there exists a constant $C$, depending only on $p$ and $n$, such that \[ (20) \quad \| u\| _{C^{0,\gamma }(\R ^n)} \le C\| u\| _{W^{1,p}(\R ^n)} \] for all $u \in C^1(\R ^n)$, where \[ \gamma := 1 - n/p. \]

Proof

\sketch Radial integration gives an average oscillation bound by the Riesz kernel. Holder inequality yields the uniform bound and the estimate $|u(x)-u(y)|\le C|x-y|^{1-n/p}\| Du\| _{L^p}$.

□
